name: inbox
description: The Gmail copilot that reads what no reader reads: a relationship-ranked digest from your own local trust graph, the social commitments layer (who owes you a reply, who's waiting on you, what you promised with dates), a local attachment vault, newsletter archaeology with evidence, and a document bridge that feeds paper-radar straight from your mailbox. Read-only: never sends, never deletes.

inbox.description: Gmail digest ranked by relationships, open loops, document bridge, newsletter cleanup

interface.shortDescription: Your Gmail, read by relationships — not by content.
interface.longDescription: Connects your Gmail with your own Google Cloud OAuth client (bring-your-own credentials, loopback redirect, tokens stored only in the plugin data directory — no third-party cloud ever sees your mail). Then it reads the layers no email reader reads: a daily digest ranked by your own local trust graph (humans first, security alerts when they matter, newsletters never, with deterministic reasons per row); the social commitments layer — waiting-on threads with aging, reply debt, and your outbound promises paired with dates; a content-hashed local attachment vault so 'the PDF María sent in March' is one search; newsletter archaeology as an evidence-backed kill-list from List-Unsubscribe headers; and a document bridge that turns renewal notices, policies and invoices into paper-radar ledger entries automatically. Strictly read-only plus label triage: it never sends, never deletes, never unsubscribes for you.
